name: VLC
about: Plays almost any video or audio file.

name: Kdenlive
about: Video editor. Used in place of Premiere Pro or Final Cut.

name: OBS Studio
about: Records the screen and streams video.

name: Audacity
about: Records and edits sound.

name: GIMP
about: Photo editor and painting tool. Used in place of Photoshop; it is a different program with different files.

name: Krita
about: Digital painting. Used in place of Photoshop or Clip Studio for drawing.

name: Inkscape
about: Vector drawing. Used in place of Illustrator; it is a different program and layouts can differ.

name: Blender
about: 3D modelling and animation.

name: LibreOffice
about: Documents, spreadsheets and slides. Opens and saves Word, Excel and PowerPoint formats; complex layouts can differ.

name: ONLYOFFICE
about: Documents, spreadsheets and slides. Opens most Word, Excel and PowerPoint files; complex layouts can differ.

name: Thunderbird
about: Email.

name: Signal
about: Private messaging.

name: KeePassXC
about: Password manager that keeps its file on this computer.

name: Bitwarden
about: Password manager that syncs through Bitwarden's servers unless you host your own.

name: ProtonVPN
about: VPN service from Proton.

name: Spotify
about: Music streaming. Closed-source app.

name: VSCodium
about: Code editor built from VS Code's open source, without Microsoft's telemetry.

name: Bottles
about: Runs Windows apps in a container.

name: darktable
about: Develops and organises RAW photos. Used in place of Lightroom; it is a different program.

name: Scribus
about: Page layout for print and PDF. Used in place of InDesign; it is a different program.

name: PDF Arranger
about: Merges, splits, rotates and reorders pages of PDF files.
